name: omni-migration
description: Migrate Omni Analytics dashboards into Hex as either a classic app (native SQL, input, and EXPLORE/METRIC/pivot cells in an app layout) or a generative app, chosen per dashboard. This coding agent pulls each dashboard via the Omni API — tile queries, every model layer's YAML, and Omni's own generated SQL and result rows per tile — compiles the semantic queries into the SQL they mean, and writes a migration brief; Hex's notebook agent builds the chosen app form on gated SQL cells; then it's verified with a SQL-fidelity gate anchored on result parity against Omni, a cell-spec diff (classic), and a visual-QA loop.
